question:
**Study the given pie - chart carefully and answer the following question.**

The entire fund that the school gets from different sources is equal to Rs. 10 lakh

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b0fba919a2f3c2a5ea4d6b116764a6b631259ea9b419574fd08a75ee9885450b.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b02154328ec95f03a89fdda6a9db939021695fd72ee370772f566cb5e675260f.png] 

What is the difference between the funds (in Rs.) acquired by the school from donations and those from government agencies?
solution:
**Given:- **

Funds from Donations = 35% of Rs. 10,00,000 (10 lacks)

Funds from Government Agencies = 12% of Rs. 10,00,000 (10 lakh) 

**Calculations:-**

Funds from Donations = (35/100) × 10,00,000 = Rs. 3,50,000

Funds from Government Agencies = (12/100) × 10,00,000 = Rs. 1,20,000 

Difference = Funds from Donations - Funds from Government Agencies Difference

⇒ Rs. 3,50,000 - Rs. 1,20,000 = Rs. 2,30,000 

**∴ The difference is Rs.__ 2,30,000__. **
